finding: Y-axis repair may flip separations onto an already solved X axis. Coordinate descent cannot necessarily restore a feasible chain because individual coordinate intervals can be empty until several bodies move together. Previously this caused rejection without solving the final assignment.
correction: Only after existing repair/descent leaves invalid edges, solve each invalid axis with zero permitted flips, record each reconciliation, then descend and validate all edges and existing physical/hard constraints. At most one reconciliation per axis; no extra separation search or relaxed hardware constraints. Contradictory assignments remain rejected with explicit negative-cycle diagnostics.
